title: Five subsections are shown in the expected order
test_data: Expected h3 order: Testing Data; Local Sourcing; No Acid, No Sand; Recycling for Reduced Impact; Eco-Friendly Packaging Solutions
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll slowly from top to bottom so every section is revealed (some sections are hidden until scrolled into view)
Read the h3 headings under the "Environmental Values" h2 in order
expected_result: The h2 "Environmental Values" is followed by exactly these 5 h3 subsections in this order (note "No Acid, No Sand" is a single subsection). Only headings and order are asserted, not full copy.
